prompt: Work autonomously and do not ask questions. Implement `max_value(weights, values, capacity)` in src/lib.rs for 0/1 knapsack: each item may be used at most once, and the total weight must not exceed `capacity`. Return the largest achievable value as `Some(u64)`, or `None` if the slice lengths differ. Keep the public API and the existing tests unchanged. Run `cargo test` and finish only when the tests pass.
